=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:143,205-207,376,462-467,501 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The kill switch `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED` is not wired through the ten final-CI step `env:` blocks in ci.yml, and the Phase 10 Files list omits ci.yml and the contract-test extension.
  WHY: Setting the repo variable to false has no effect, so the accept path stays on and the "rollback without a code change" promise fails.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:354-357 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: For a PR based on the default branch, every commit in the range is a default-branch commit, so condition 2 is vacuous and acceptance depends only on file disjointness.
  WHY: This contradicts the claim that only sync merges and resolver commits are accepted, and it weakens the "never test a meaningfully old base" guarantee.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:352-354 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `tested_base` is defined as "the merge commit's first parent", but `first` in scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh is reassigned at line 159 and printed at lines 181-182, so it can differ from the checked-out HEAD's first parent.
  WHY: The overlap check can cover the wrong range relative to the tree under test.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:357 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The overlap test compares only `filename` and ignores `previous_filename` for renamed files.
  WHY: A sync that renames a file the PR modifies is accepted as disjoint.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:77,352-357,495 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The conditions cannot detect an old base that was already broken and later fixed by a sync merge (the #9602 shape), and D10's guarantee conflicts with the R7 risk entry. Severity disagreement: sonnet and glm rated this nit, gemini rated it major.
  WHY: The guard accepts the stale ref, the suite runs on the broken base, and the final run fails, so the stated guarantee is overstated.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:365 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: "Up to three extra GETs" is wrong, because the 3000-file paginated listing at 100 per page is up to 30 requests. Severity disagreement: minimax rated this major, the others nit.
  WHY: The wrong number would be copied into the script header, and burst rate-limit exhaustion fails closed as `detail=api_error`.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:75-80 | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: D10 is placed before D9, so the Decisions list reads D8, D10, D9.
  WHY: This breaks the numbering order and makes cross-references harder to follow.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:364,376,379 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The registry update names only `outcome=stale_accepted`, not the `detail=` field, and a new agents.d fragment would register `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF` twice because agents.d/9602-final-ci-base-sync.md already holds it. Severity disagreement: minimax rated the duplicate-registration part major, the others nit.
  WHY: The `detail=` field ships undocumented and the prefix is registered twice.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:366-371 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The plan says "stubbed API server, as the file already does", but the harness uses a fake `gh` script (tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py:25-46) plus a `file://` URL and has no HTTP server.
  WHY: An implementer cannot route the new compare and files endpoints through the existing harness.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:354-357 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A sync merge is recognised only by its two-parent shape and an author-controlled subject, and the second parent is not required to be in the default-branch set.
  WHY: A crafted merge passes as a sync merge, leaving file overlap as the only gate.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:134671852845 | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The lint (job 134671852845) and static-checks (job 134670117024) failures are the existing guard's `outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed` exit from scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh lines 181-183, which this docs-only PR does not touch.
  WHY: They are the R7 incident itself and clear when the head is synced.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The new behaviour sits behind `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED` (default `true`), and every phase can be turned off without a code change.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml (ten final-CI step env blocks) and tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py::test_every_final_ci_checkout_is_followed_by_the_check
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The Phase 10 hunks (lines 143, 205-207, 376, 462-467) do not name ci.yml, and step 3 says the contract tests stay unchanged. The existing `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_FRESH_ENABLED` is passed in ten ci.yml env blocks (lines 164, 737, 1355, 1853, 2475, 3266, 4077, 4384, 4528, 4640).
- requirement: Phase 10 step 3 says to extend tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py with a "stubbed API server, as the file already does".
  expected_change_site: Phase 10 step 3; FAKE_GH in tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py:25-46
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The harness has only a fake `gh` answering the `.mergeable` and `.base.ref` filters plus a `file://` URL. No HTTP server exists, and `gh api` with a token bypasses `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_API_URL`.
- requirement: Phase 10 step 4 adds the new `outcome=stale_accepted` value to the `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF` log-prefix registry entry and an agents.d block (§25).
  expected_change_site: agents.d/9602-final-ci-base-sync.md (line 26 registry bullet, line 29 LOG_PREFIX line)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The Phase 10 Files list names only a new agents.d/<issue>-final-ci-sync-only-merge-ref.md fragment, while the registry entry is in the existing 9602 fragment, so the prefix would be registered twice.
- requirement: The Phase 10 failure path logs `detail=<first failed condition>` (not_ahead, truncated, foreign_commit, file_overlap, api_error).
  expected_change_site: Phase 10 step 4 registry update (line 379); agents.d/9602-final-ci-base-sync.md line 26
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The registry update names only `outcome=stale_accepted`, and the `detail=` field is not documented in the contractual log-prefix registry.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:Phase 10 step 1 condition 2 (~356) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A sync merge is recognised only by its two-parent shape and an exact subject string, and the second parent is not required to be in the default-branch commit set.
  WHY: A crafted merge passes as a sync merge, leaving the file-overlap check as the only gate.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:354-355 (against D10 line 76 and R7 line 495) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: For a PR based on the default branch every commit in the range is in the default-branch set, so condition 2 passes for any stale main-based ref.
  WHY: This contradicts "only sync merges and resolver commits are accepted" and weakens the old-base guarantee.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:352 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `first` in scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh is reassigned at line 159 and printed at lines 181-182, so it can differ from the checked-out HEAD after line 166.
  WHY: The compare range could be built from a different base than the tree under test; `tested_base` should be read from `git rev-parse HEAD^1`.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:357 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The overlap test compares only `filename`, not `previous_filename`.
  WHY: A sync that renames a file the PR modifies is accepted as disjoint.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:77,495 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The three conditions cannot detect an already-broken old base that a sync merge has since fixed (the #9602 shape).
  WHY: The final run fails and the PR returns to review, and R7 covers only the "base-only break caught later" case.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:365 vs 357 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: "Up to three extra GETs" is wrong, because the paginated 3000-file listing is up to 30 requests.
  WHY: Burst rate-limit exhaustion would fail closed as `detail=api_error`.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:364,379 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The registry update omits the `detail=` field, and a new fragment would double-register `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF` already held in agents.d/9602-final-ci-base-sync.md.
  WHY: The field ships undocumented and the prefix may be registered twice.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:75-80 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: D10 appears before D9.
  WHY: Numbering order is broken, with no runtime effect.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:143,207,462-467 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new kill switch is not passed through the ten ci.yml step `env:` blocks, and the plan says "no ci.yml wiring change".
  WHY: Setting the variable to false does nothing, so rollback without a code change fails.
- CI check failures (lint job 134671852845, static-checks job 134670117024) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both are `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF ... outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed` from scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh lines 181-183, untouched by this docs-only PR.
  WHY: They are the R7 incident itself and clear when the head is synced.
